svg.title: Azure Monitor Lab architecture
svg.desc: Workloads, telemetry collection, dashboards, and response. Azure Monitor Agent sends standalone VM OpenTelemetry metrics to the Azure Monitor workspace alongside classic Log Analytics monitoring. Application Insights and alerts feed Azure Copilot Observability Agent, which stores correlated issues in a dedicated Azure Monitor workspace. GitHub Copilot CLI consumes central monitoring context for guided investigations. Azure Container Registry supplies a digest-pinned image to the Container Apps Job used for approved lab operations.
svg.text: Optional Foundry and agent stages use their documented supported regions
